stage0046a_03:r_b05f6a6e8f3d9b24.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Born into this world, time after time,
　wrapped each time in grief,
　that grief embraced by God in heaven.」

stage0046a_03:r_ec335e69f984b8b3.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「That is the beautiful principle...
　But his... $$ジン・ムソウ$$'s soul strayed from it,
　and reached for greater heights.」

stage0046a_03:r_0abcaf0c31978670.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「For the last child's remains are not here...
　What this tells us: even without dreaming
　of an unseen next life, Altair won't perish.」

stage0046a_03:r_1d6bc48b7f246730.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「There is nothing to fear.
　The last child... $$ジン・ムソウ$$ taught us this:
　we live in the midst of a miracle.」

stage0046a_03:r_6fd81f4abebe60c5.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Did raising the people's morale with
　$$ジン$$'s death not please you?」

stage0046a_03:r_495d61d3ec7e16f2.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「$$ジン$$'s infiltration into Vega was a great blessing.」

stage0046a_03:r_5cd353758cfe474d.text:
$$イズモ$$
「But you sacrificed $$ジン$$... Altair's last child!」

stage0046a_03:r_a653c8dec4c0f06f.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「He gave Altair a great deal.
　Enough to be worth the price of his life...」

stage0046a_03:r_09d0fcc600cdd3df.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「The strongest $$レア・イグラー$$s...
　In other words, contact with true Eve candidates...
　And at long last, they have appeared.」

stage0046a_03:r_182faded068c15ed.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「The reincarnation of the Wings of the sun...」

stage0046a_03:r_6e558bc69acf5bf3.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「$$ジン$$'s soul must know what he achieved,
　and tremble with joy.」

stage0046a_03:r_d60d0818e965232f.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Yes... next time, he might be reborn
　as the first child of a new Altair.」

stage0046a_03:r_6fd86c96891ea942.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Well then, if you'll excuse me.」

stage0046a_03:r_d80a9688790ed583.text:
$$イズモ$$
（Iron-C, spanning the whole of Altair,
　that my mother Oriza created...）

stage0046a_03:r_708bea61e3c43ada.text:
$$イズモ$$
（It was a system meant to promise
　this world prosperity and peace.）

stage0046a_03:r_7b6f159eeaf4de0f.text:
$$イズモ$$
（And yet, output drops with no known cause,
　control system errors, repeated explosions...）

stage0046a_03:r_0827963cfd706e8d.text:
$$イズモ$$
（No system lasts forever.
　I understand that much...
　But this is far too soon...）

stage0046a_03:r_ff6f8bdca2dd2bc9.text:
$$イズモ$$
（$$ジン$$... is this the beginning of the end for Altair...?
　Or is it punishment for me...?）

stage0046a_03:r_3f4035fd9db81258.text:
$$イズモ$$
（And that must be affecting Vega too...）
